title: Grouped-query attention
summary: GQA forward with H query heads and G shared key and value groups, plus mean pooling of a multi-head checkpoint into groups.

paper.title: GQA: Training Generalized Multi-Query Transformer Models from Multi-Head Checkpoints

mutants.no_divisibility_check: Does not raise ValueError when n_heads is not a multiple of n_kv_heads.
mutants.pool_sum_not_mean: Sums the heads of each group in place of the mean.
mutants.pool_wrong_grouping: Reshapes the projection to (D, r, G, d_head), so each group pools heads that are G apart.
mutants.scale_by_d_model: Divides the scores by sqrt(D), not by sqrt(d_head).
mutants.tile_not_repeat: Uses np.tile, so query head h uses group h mod G and not group h // r.
